newsitem.title: USA: White House briefed on Boeing-McDonnell merger.
newsitem.headline: White House briefed on Boeing-McDonnell merger.

text.p: The White House was briefed on the merger of the Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp prior to its announcement on Sunday, a White House spokesman said, declining further comment on the matter.

White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters company executives briefed outgoing White House Chief of Staff Leon Panetta on the $13.3 billion transaction and that Panetta had in turn told the president.
The deal is expected to require anti-trust approval from the Justice Department, but McCurry declined all comment on the matter pending any Justice Department review.
